content.introduction: The sources provide historical data up to May 2026, including mixed performances in Asia markets, European markets closing lower and higher on different days, and the S&P 500 closing higher due to a chip comeback and an Iran-Israel peace deal. The Nikkei 225 and S&P/ASX 200 indices are also noted with their declines. The investing.com source lists current indices, showing declines in the Tadawul All Share and Nikkei 225, and a slight rise in the DAX. The groww.in source shows the S&P 500 slightly down, the Nikkei 225 down significantly, and the Hang Seng down as well. The sources do not provide current live data for October 2026.
